summary: Both critical iteration-1 bugs are FIXED. Backend regression: 17/17 pytest tests PASS (auth, resumes CRUD + max-5, /jobs/fetch, /jobs list + grad filter, /jobs/{id}/match via Claude, cover-letter via Claude, applications POST/GET/PATCH, preferences GET/PUT, stats, resume DELETE). Frontend e2e via mongo-injected session cookie: dashboard, job detail, tracker kanban, settings, resumes — all render and integrate with backend. AI Match + Cover Letter buttons returned 400 ONLY because the freshly seeded FE user had no resume uploaded (expected guard behaviour — verified separately in backend tests). Save-to-tracker round-trips to the Kanban Saved column.

minor.issue: server.py uses allow_origins='*' together with allow_credentials=True — invalid per CORS spec; browsers typically reject credentialed requests. Currently works only because the frontend is on the same preview host so the request is same-origin proxied. Tighten to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL origin to be safe.
Bare except swallows LLM errors silently with no log; on failure the parsed_meta returns empty skills/summary without indicating why.

Response sometimes reports saved=0 even though 50 jobs were fetched (existing duplicates by job_id+source); not a bug but UI shows the same count. Consider returning a 'new' count vs 'refreshed' count for clarity.

integration_issues.flow: AI Match / Cover Letter on JobDetail without a resume
integration_issues.issue: Buttons issue request and surface a console 400 with no in-UI toast/banner telling the user 'Upload a resume first'. Add a friendly empty-state when /api/resumes is empty.

action_items: (Optional polish) Show a 'No resume uploaded — upload one in /resumes' empty-state on JobDetail when GET /api/resumes returns []; today users get a silent 400.
(Optional) Fix CORS allow_origins='*' + credentials=True; set explicit origin from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
(Optional) Add logging in services/llm.py parse_resume_ai except branch.
critical_code_review_comments: services/jobs.py _ensure_aware() fix verified — fetch_all_jobs now returns 50 jobs reliably.
server.py POST /api/applications upsert now builds set_fields without app_id/created_at — Mongo no longer rejects; PATCH and embedded-job GET also work.
Frontend api.js uses withCredentials:true + cookie session_token — works end-to-end via mongo injection.
All key interactive elements expose data-testid (verified across Dashboard, JobDetail, Tracker, Settings, Resumes, TopNav).
test_credentials: Mongo-injected session per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend pytest fixture creates UID+TOKEN per run. Frontend e2e used token test_session_fe_1779181449_48b84d for user FE Tester.
seed_data_creation: /tmp/test_resume.docx (Python SWE) regenerated for resume upload tests; mongo user+session+preferences inserted for FE run (not auto-cleaned — main agent may run the cleanup one-liner from test_credentials.md if desired).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_applymate_au.py pass in ~4s. Frontend cookie-based auth confirmed working via Mongo session injection; URL is https://jobhunt-agent.preview.emergentagent.com (from frontend/.env, NOT the host noted in review_request). For JobDetail match/cover-letter, ensure the test user has at least one resume — pytest covers that. Only remaining nits are CORS config and a friendlier empty-state when no resume is uploaded.
rca of the issue: Iteration 1 critical bugs (1) services/jobs.py tz-naive vs tz-aware datetime compare and (2) server.py applications upsert $set+$setOnInsert app_id conflict are both resolved. Verified by re-running the full pytest regression and by exercising the live UI end-to-end with cookie-injected auth.
